The food is roasted squash or pumpkin in about 6 chunks. Together they cover an area of roughly 150 px by 230 px, which is about 11 cm by 16 cm at the extremes, though the chunks don't fill that area. Each chunk is about 5 cm by 3 cm by 2 cm, or roughly 30 cm³, which is about 30 g. Six chunks would be about 180 g, but some are smaller, so I'll estimate about 150 g.

Roasted squash is roughly 0.4 to 0.5 kcal/g, and the oil and caramelization push that to about 0.8 kcal/g. That gives about 120 kcal for 150 g.
